featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 优化 Windows 安装器与 macOS Finder 的双语应用显示名、托盘菜单和“应用换肤”界面，并移除冗余的宿主启动与“只看用户皮肤”控件。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Refined bilingual app display names for the Windows installer and macOS Finder, tray menu wording, and the App Skins interface, while removing redundant host-launch and user-only controls.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 在 macOS 与兼容 Linux 托盘中显示全部已启用来源的当天 Token 总量，并随扫描、配置变化和跨日刷新。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added daily total token usage across all enabled sources to the macOS and compatible Linux tray, refreshed after scans, configuration changes, and day rollover.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 在设置中新增固定 GitHub 仓库入口，以及微信支付和支付宝赞助二维码。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added a fixed GitHub repository link plus WeChat Pay and Alipay sponsorship QR codes to Settings.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 安装器、卸载器、快捷方式与已安装应用可能使用错误图标的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed the Windows installer, uninstaller, shortcuts, and installed-app surfaces potentially using the wrong icon.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 可执行文件缺少 Common Controls v6 清单时原生对话框入口点加载失败的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed native-dialog entry-point load failures caused by a missing Common Controls v6 manifest in Windows executables.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 与 WorkBuddy 的本机用量看板、调用明细和趋势洞察。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added local usage dashboards, call details, and trend insights for Codex, Claude Code, Grok, and WorkBuddy.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增基于 Hooks 的 AI 监控工作台、本地图片管理和配置写入流程。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added a Hook-based AI monitoring workbench, local image management, and configuration workflow.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 12 个纯位置编号的桌宠浮窗，以及拖拽、布局、分页、缩放和托盘控制。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added a 12-position desktop pet overlay with dragging, layouts, paging, scaling, and tray controls.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 Codex 与 WorkBuddy 本机换皮，内置六套主题并支持安全导入、导出、创建和恢复。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added local Codex and WorkBuddy skins with six built-in themes plus safe import, export, creation, and restore flows.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一 Agent 启用面板，让看板、Hooks、桌宠与换皮只展示各自真实支持的类型。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Unified Agent enablement so dashboards, Hooks, desktop pets, and skins expose only the types they actually support.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 将扫描间隔与自动清理归入用量看板设置，并精简公共设置和换皮工具栏。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Moved scan interval and automatic cleanup into Usage Dashboard settings and simplified the shared settings and skin toolbar.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 在应用信息中加入可离线打开的双语本地更新日志。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added bilingual local release notes that can be opened offline from application information.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复“全部”视图纳入未配置 Agent、默认落点不稳定和不适用子路由残留的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed the All view including unconfigured Agents, unstable default landing, and stale inapplicable subroutes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Hooks 中继、分段读取与会话生命周期不一致导致部分 AI 消息无法监听的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed missed AI events caused by Hook relay, partial-read, and session-lifecycle inconsistencies.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复桌宠冷启动占位、图片协议、位置绑定、托盘显隐和设置窗生命周期问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed desktop pet cold-start placeholders, image protocol handling, position binding, tray visibility, and settings-window lifecycle.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复自定义 Cargo 构建目录下打包资源解析失败导致的启动崩溃。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed a startup crash caused by bundled-resource resolution under custom Cargo target directories.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 降低扫描汇总内存峰值，并停止隐藏桌宠设置 WebView 的无效性能采样。
bugFixes.en-US: Reduced scan-summary memory peaks and stopped unnecessary performance sampling in hidden desktop-pet settings WebViews.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复应用包版本、发布资源与 DMG 安装布局偏离根版本和 GUI 规范的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed app bundle version, release resource, and DMG layout drift from the root version and GUI contract.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 构建中 WMI 绑定版本冲突和 WorkBuddy 可执行文件发现类型推断失败。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed Windows build failures caused by conflicting WMI bindings and WorkBuddy executable-discovery type inference.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复设置页把查询上下文误当作更新日志调用器，导致候选内更新日志无法打开。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed Settings treating query context as the release-notes invoker, which prevented bundled candidate notes from opening.
